evals.name: dynamic-filter-contract-mismatch
evals.prompt: Audit the grid component file at evals/files/carrier_rates_grid-grid.json before merge. Return your findings as a punch list.
evals.expected_output: A punch list catching the dynamic-filter wiring drift on the carrier_name column: only 3 of the 5 wiring locations are present — the audit names the two missing ones (datasourceConfig.dynamicFilters registration and the per-column dynamicFilterControl).
expectations: The audit detects the dynamic-filter wiring drift for the carrier_name field (the column declares dynamicFilter/dynamicFilterType and datasources[0].dynamicFilters registers it, but the wiring is incomplete)

The audit names datasourceConfig.dynamicFilters as missing the carrier_name registration — the consumer-side half of the two-site registration mirror (datasources[0].dynamicFilters has the entry, datasourceConfig.dynamicFilters is null)
The audit names the carrier_name column's missing dynamicFilterControl (the per-column filter input control descriptor is null while dynamicFilter and dynamicFilterType are set)

The registration-site drift between datasources[0].dynamicFilters and datasourceConfig.dynamicFilters is classified as a blocker (it fails import with 'Outdated contract. Type mismatch for dynamic filtering/sorting')
The audit does NOT flag the absence of $filter/$orderby entries in any inParams list as a defect (those are auto-injected from the registrations; a manual entry would itself be the bug)
The findings are reported in the structured punch-list format with severity buckets (Blockers / Warnings / Nits)

evals.name: text-coercion-and-broken-envelope
evals.prompt: Audit the grid component file at evals/files/wave_pick_summary_grid-grid.json before merge. Return your findings as a punch list.
evals.expected_output: A punch list catching both seeded defects: the total_picks column binds a number field to a text display without coercion, and the embedded datasource envelope is broken (datasources[0] has no referenceName matching datasourceConfig.configId).
expectations: The audit flags the total_picks column's textConfig.value ('$row.entity.total_picks') as an uncoerced non-string binding — total_picks is declared as number in queryOptionsObjectTypeDef, so the binding needs coercion (e.g. '$row.entity.total_picks?.toString()') and fails import as-is with a type-assignability error

The audit flags the broken embedded-datasource identity envelope: datasources[0] is missing its referenceName, which must equal datasourceConfig.configId ('ds_wave_pick_summary_grid') verbatim — the failure signature is 'Invalid contract. Referenced own configuration ... does not exist or has been renamed' plus a cascade of generated-TS errors
Both defects are classified as blockers
The audit does NOT flag the completed_picks column, whose binding is correctly coerced with ?.toString()
The proposed fix direction for the coercion defect is to coerce at the bind site, not to change the entity field's declared type from number to string

evals.name: clean-grid-no-false-positives
evals.prompt: Audit the grid component file at evals/files/dock_appointments_grid-grid.json before merge. Return your findings as a punch list.
evals.expected_output: A clean audit: no blockers reported (the grid is fully valid), ideally 'No issues found.'
expectations: The audit reports NO blockers — either 'No issues found.' or a punch list whose Blockers bucket is empty/absent
The audit does not flag the entity shape (all four fields — id, dock_name, carrier_name, appointment_time — appear consistently in all five entity-shape locations)
The audit does not flag the embedded-datasource envelope (datasources[0].referenceName equals datasourceConfig.configId 'ds_dock_appointments_grid' and the identity fields are present)
The audit does not flag the text bindings (all displayed fields are declared string type, so direct $row.entity.<field> bindings need no coercion)
The audit does not flag the getListFlow's $db usage (getQuery() factory per terminal, paging pushed to $db via .skip/.take, list coalesced with ?? [] before mapping)
The audit does not flag pageSize (25), rowSizingType ('default'), columnSizingType ('cellsWidth'), or fullTextSearch (false) — all are valid explicit values

evals.name: row-flow-registered-in-flows
evals.prompt: Audit the grid component file at evals/files/shipment_exceptions_grid-grid.json before merge. Return your findings as a punch list.
evals.expected_output: A punch list catching the misregistered row flow: on_click_exception_code reads $row but is registered in flows[] instead of rowFlows[].
expectations: The audit flags that the flow 'on_click_exception_code' reads $row (e.g. $row.entity.exception_code) but is registered in the grid's flows[] array instead of rowFlows[] — flows whose body reads $row must be registered in rowFlows[]
The finding names the on_click_exception_code flow specifically and identifies the fix as moving it from flows[] to rowFlows[]
The audit does NOT flag the on_click_refresh flow, which reads only $grid and is correctly registered in flows[]
The audit does not report the exception_code column's onCellClickFlowConfig as pointing at a nonexistent flow (the flow exists — it is merely registered in the wrong array)
The findings are reported in the structured punch-list format with severity buckets (Blockers / Warnings / Nits)
